name: client-intelligence
description: Primary repository of client-level knowledge. Admins author named templates that define mandatory and optional fields; members create client instances from templates and extend them with their own fields. v2.0.0 — two-tier visibility model (MAJOR, breaking): clients are PRIVATE by default (stored in the member's own My Drive, owner-applied sharing: share=read, collaborator=read+write, via permission-change-helper with verified outcomes) or ORG-PUBLIC (stored in the org commons under uniform all@ writer access with mandatory changelog attribution). New transition-client task moves clients between tiers. A universal visibility floor — one pointer record per client in public-index/ — keeps every client's name, owner, and tier org-discoverable while data is gated by tier. Replaces the 1.x per-instance ACL model, which Drive made impossible for non-admin creators (folder grants on Shared Drives are Manager-only — finding F12) and which carried the ancestor-leak limitation; both issues are structurally dissolved. Soft-delete semantics: floor records are permanent history; archival is the default lifecycle verb. Requires agent-index-core 3.9.0+ (My Drive member spaces), adapter 2.5.0+ (ID anchors), permission-helper-go 0.4.1+. 1.x upgrade requires the gated-instance review in upgrade/1-to-2.md BEFORE provisioning (data-exposure control).
